slides.texte_overlay:
How to keep a long-distance
relationship strong
Plan the next visit before the current one ends. Having a date in the calendar makes the distance much easier to live with.
Have a call routine. A short call every evening, a longer one at weekends. Rhythm creates closeness when you can't see each other.
Do things together from afar. Watch the same film, cook the same recipe, play an online game. Shared activities beat endless chatting.
Be honest about how you feel. Missing someone is normal. Talking about it calmly prevents small frustrations from growing.
Before: our calls kept repeating the same topics. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I always bring something new to share.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our calls kept repeating the same topics. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always bring something new to share.

slides.texte_overlay: Keep your own life full. Friends, sport, projects. A happy, busy life makes you a better partner, near or far.
Talk about the future. Where you'll live, when the distance ends. A shared goal keeps you both moving forward.
